response.sql: SELECT c.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college), 0) AS share FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY c.state

assumptions.assumption: The total means all player_college records, including unmatched records.
Each college_id identifies at most one college, so a matched player_college record contributes to one state.

alternatives.interpretation: The total means only player_college records that match a college.
alternatives.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT c.state FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id), state_counts AS (SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM matched GROUP BY state) SELECT state, count, CAST(count AS REAL) / SUM(count) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts
